text_summary.english_description:
[StartBattle] Targets the unit that has the lowest HP
- At 7 [BoseProjektil], primarily targets among allies as the main target
[StartBattle] Gain +1 Atk Weight for every 3 [BoseProjektil] on self (max 2)
[WhenUse] <style="highlight">Coin Power +1 for every 5 [Breath] on self (max 2)</style>
[WhenUse] <style="highlight">Base Power +1 for every 3 [Breath] Count on self (max 2)</style>

[EndSkill] Lose ([BoseProjektil] on self x 2) SP (max 14)
[EndSkill] If this unit has 7 [BoseProjektil] at Combat Start, lose them all
- If this unit lost all [BoseProjektil], and if an ally is killed, heal 20 SP on self

coin_texts.en: This Coin deals damage only against the main target

If the main target is an ally, activate the following effects:
- The main target's Pierce Resistance becomes Fatal against this attack
- Deal +7% damage for every [BoseProjektil] on self (max 49%)
- +3% Damage on Critical Hit for every [Breath] on self (max 60%)
This Coin deals damage only against the sub-targets
- However, if the main target was an enemy, deal damage against the main target
- If the first Coin failed to kill an ally, 1 random sub-target takes damage
Deal +<style="highlight">20</style>% damage for every [BoseProjektil] on self (max <style="highlight">140</style>%)
- If the first Coin killed an ally, deal +<style="highlight">40</style>% damage for every [BoseProjektil] on self instead (max <style="highlight">280</style>%)
+<style="highlight">5</style>% Damage on Critical Hit for every [Breath] Potency (max <style="highlight">50</style>%)
+<style="highlight">10</style>% Damage on Critical Hit for every [BoseProjektil] on self (max <style="highlight">70</style>%)
Deal +(HP percentage the first Coin removed from the main target)% damage (max 100%)
- If the first Coin killed an ally, inflict <style="highlight">5</style> [Laceration] and +<style="highlight">2</style> [Laceration] Count instead
